Rahul Gandhi Accuses Amit Shah of Shielding Attacker

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has accused Union Home Minister Amit Shah of shielding a man who allegedly attacked the father of a Dalit student. Gandhi stated that the attacker was roaming free, implying protection from the Home Minister. The accusation was made in relation to an incident involving a Dalit student's father, though specific details of the incident, the attacker's identity, and the victim were not provided in the coverage.
